gate_criteria.description: All secrets separated, least privilege enforced, timing attacks defended
verified_points: Negative SQL permission boundaries on PG16: api_runtime denied economy writes (wallets, ledger), worker_runtime denied ledger & receipts writes, DDL (CREATE/DROP) denied for all runtime roles with 42501.
Credential mode separation: hybrid cookie+bearer rejected (401 AMBIGUOUS_CREDENTIAL), mutating cookie requests enforce Origin/Referer (403 CSRF_REJECTED), bearer bypasses CSRF.
Header sanitizer: untrusted callers stripped of x-actor-id, x-test-actor, x-forwarded-for; internal gateway preserved.
Body size limit enforcement: request bodies > 100KB rejected with 413 BODY_TOO_LARGE.
Audit HMAC verification: dedicated HMAC-SHA256 signature chain over audit.operator_audit; detects chain breaks and tampering; DB immutability triggers block mutations.
Operator protection: /admin/*, /metrics, /operator/* rejected on public ingress with 403 PRIVATE_OPERATOR_ROUTE.
